limitations: Reused adaptive development labels; descriptive associations, not causal effects or independent hypothesis tests.
No individual records or label values exported; only aggregates and provenance hashes.
Identical feature vectors with different labels are not established data errors or a generalization upper bound.
Known-attribute consistency cannot prove missing-value truth; hidden values are not observable.
Univariate train/test similarity does not rule out multivariate/conditional shift.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: For a mean-imputing model, observed CryoSleep=True identifies missing service amounts as structural zeros; replacing only these missing amounts may retain information that unconditional means blur.
testable_hypotheses.already_tested: run009 v26/v28 tested broader logical filling on CatBoost engineered inputs; run043 added group attributes/fills, run052 added Mitra missing flags. These are not the exact raw-Mitra, Cryo-only amount-fill ablation; previous failures lower the prior.
testable_hypotheses.minimal_test_if_authorized: Freeze raw Mitra13 vs same checkpoint/preprocessing with only missing spend under observed CryoSleep=True set to zero, before fold-local means. No children/Cryo inference/extra flags/routing/threshold changes. Original three development folds; matched cached raw after identity checks. Verify unchanged observed cells and rules first.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Any observed nonzero amount in the condition challenges an exact rule; if authorized CV gives no predeclared aggregate accuracy/logloss gain, archive rather than adding more rules.
testable_hypotheses.scope: Representation hypothesis, not label correction; no experiment executed here.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: A generic unanimous-peer fill can corrupt Destination/Deck/Cryo, while HomePlanet/Side may obey stronger observed group consistency; group-context bundle failures cannot isolate which assumption failed.
testable_hypotheses.already_tested: run009 unanimous fill and run043 Mitra context20 were executed bundles; surname HomePlanet run017 and soft HomePlanet marginal run029 also tested. No justification to blindly repeat these bundles.
testable_hypotheses.minimal_test_if_authorized: First predeclare attribute-only group-held-out masking validation stratified by known-peer count, with no Transported usage. Only a rule with negligible held-out attribute errors and material actual-missing coverage can motivate a later matched task experiment.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Nontrivial attribute error on observed peer-unanimous rows or tiny true-missing coverage rejects deterministic filling. Random observed-mask success still need not transfer to actual missingness.
testable_hypotheses.scope: Current leave-one-value-out evidence is descriptive and transductive, not independent validation.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Earth, DeckG, age and sleep/spending composition overlap, so separate weak slice scores may describe the same hard population. Conditional spatial variation could remain, but mixed labels do not establish erroneous labels.
testable_hypotheses.already_tested: Graph/peer residual diagnostics already weak with confidence intervals crossing zero; no test/train GroupId or Cabin label-neighbor coverage. Label smoothing was tested without accuracy improvement.
testable_hypotheses.minimal_test_if_authorized: First compare existing group-OOF residuals in the fixed Planet×Deck×Cryo and rank-quartile cells, using group clusters and no fitted correction. Main agent owns OOF analysis. Only repeated conditional residual structure beyond existing spatial expert can motivate a predeclared nested spatial model; no cutpoint/weight search. Separately stratify exact13/coarsened conflicts without relabeling.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: If Earth/G differences vanish after sleep/spend/age composition, or conditional spatial residuals are inconsistent/uncertain across frozen splits, do not add another spatial expert. No source-confirmed wrong labels means no label cleaning.
testable_hypotheses.scope: No new robust-loss model recommended from these counts alone.

single_fixed_experiment_judgment.decision: Worth one precisely matched raw-Mitra13 repair-package ablation, not a claim that cleaning explains most errors. No training authorized or executed by this diagnostic.
fixed_rules: Observed CryoSleep=True: fill only missing five-service amounts with zero.
Missing HomePlanet: fill only when all known same-GroupId roster values agree.
Missing Side: same unanimous observed-group rule.
excluded_rules: Do not fill CryoSleep, Destination, Deck, Age or CabinNumber; no child-age rule or observed-value replacement.
No new flags/counts/IDs, row filtering, label editing, or missing-only probability routing.
single_fixed_experiment_judgment.why_not_equivalent_to_prior_tests: run009 logical/unanimous CatBoost used broader rules and engineered inputs; run043 Mitra context20 also added seven columns and filled Destination/Deck, which show attribute-level counterexamples. run052 flags expose missingness rather than reconstruct values. None isolates this fixed three-rule raw-Mitra13 package.
single_fixed_experiment_judgment.fair_comparison: Original raw13 control independently built. Candidate retains same named columns/order, categorical handling, original mirror RNG policy, checkpoint, full support, query batching and threshold. Fit preprocessing only on each training fold; numerical means and model internal quantiles may legitimately change after repairs, so do not claim all transformed observed rows remain bitwise identical.
single_fixed_experiment_judgment.unlabeled_roster_boundary: Group aggregates built once from full train/test attributes with Transported excluded; IDs align rows, not input features. GroupCV remains transductive attribute use, never cross-group target propagation.
single_fixed_experiment_judgment.evaluation_proposal: Before scores, freeze original three random folds with verified raw-Mitra cached control, full shape/resource and reload validation; report paired corrections/regressions, logloss and per-fold results. A concrete resource-continue heuristic is pooled gain>=0.001, logloss not worse, >=2 folds accuracy not worse; root must freeze it before fitting. Passing does not establish stable superiority or automatically authorize upload.
single_fixed_experiment_judgment.stop: If package fails its predeclared criterion, archive; do not select individual rules, reroute repaired rows, append age rules or change weights on these OOF results.
single_fixed_experiment_judgment.counterevidence: Observed consistency does not identify missing ground truth. Missing/complete aggregate error rates are similar, related bundles have failed, and changes are confined initially to a minority of rows. Most common model errors may reflect unobserved information or conditional structure; no claim of a one-percentage-point benefit.
